method: analysis/liquidity_target_engine.py::build_liquidity_targets already has 9 comprehensive existing tests (tests/test_liquidity_target_engine.py) covering exactly this checkpoint's requirements with asset_class='forex' fixtures. 5 new GBP/USD-symbol-explicit tests added rather than duplicating that coverage.
hierarchy: M5/M15 swing candidates -> previous-day/week highs-lows -> previous-session highs-lows -> caller-supplied directional liquidity pool, clustered and scored on prominence+touches+timeframe_points+HTF-alignment+freshness+distance_realism+risk_reward

requirements_verified.satisfies_minimum_rr: PASS -- pre-existing test_distant_tp2_cannot_hide_poor_nearest_target_reward (quality_gate blocks TP1 when nearest RR is poor)

when_no_target_passes.remains_in_plan_validation: PASS -- tp1 is None, no fabricated target ever appears
when_no_target_passes.target_scope_mismatch_cannot_produce_a_t: PASS -- confirmed via the same rejection-reasons mechanism; a wrong-side/future/swept level never reaches selected_targets
